about: Where each club of the Europe maps (scripts/build-europe-maps.mjs) stands: every built-in football club and every club of the earlier seasons, EA's and the ones before them (scripts/data/retro-seasons.json), and the EuroLeague's basketball clubs (their arenas, by hand). city names its land; home is [lon, lat], its ground, from its club's row in a country map (source: that d<nation>-<FM id>) or placed by hand; shape is the world shape it holds land in when it is not its league's (the Welsh clubs of the Premier League). The women's game's European clubs (w- ids), every built-in one and every one of the earlier seasons, stand at the women's own ground: their Wikidata item's home venue (source: that item), Wikipedia's, their men's club's ground in the same town (source: as f-…) or by hand.
